current_prompt.body:
RUN the First Fit algorithm on items arriving in order [5, 5, 5, 3, 3, 3, 7, 7] with bin capacity C = 10 and REPORT the resulting packing.
FIND an optimal packing that minimizes the number of bins and REPORT it.
CALCULATE the gap between the First Fit packing and the optimal packing and REPORT the gap.
EXPLAIN why the arrival order causes First Fit to use more bins.
INCLUDE a self-test that VERIFIES both packings use all items exactly once and RESPECT the capacity constraint.
